# STAT 313 R Reference Sheets

These are reference sheets Dr. C made for STAT 313 F25, which include relevant examples for the beginning of this course.

- [Basics](r-resources/stat313-rsheet1.pdf)
- [Variables by Groups + T-test + ANOVA](r-resources/stat313-rsheet2.pdf)
  - Note, this sheet only specifies a *pooled* t-test (assuming equal variances). 
  - Change the argument to `var.equal = FALSE` for an un-pooled test and look at the documentation `?t.test` for more options.
